extraMeanings.en: to steal things from shops or homes during a riot or war
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Rioters looted several stores in the city centre overnight.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: İsyancılar gece boyunca şehir merkezindeki birçok mağazayı yağmaladı.

extraMeanings.en: a sudden strong movement to one side
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The bus gave a sudden lurch and I nearly fell over.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Otobüs aniden bir yalpaladı ve neredeyse düşüyordum.

extraMeanings.en: a clever plan or action to gain an advantage
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The deal was a clever political maneuver to win over voters.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Anlaşma, seçmenleri kazanmak için akıllıca bir siyasi manevraydı.

extraMeanings.en: a large sign over a cinema or theatre showing what is on
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Her name was up in lights on the theatre marquee.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Adı, tiyatronun ışıklı afiş panosunda yazıyordu.

extraMeanings.en: to make something less extreme or intense
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The government tried to moderate the effects of the crisis.

extraMeanings.en: an annoying or troublesome person or thing
extraMeanings.exampleEn: That dog is an absolute menace to the neighbourhood.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: O köpek mahalle için tam bir baş belası.

extraMeanings.exampleEn: Gangs continued to menace local shopkeepers.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Çeteler yerel esnafı tehdit etmeye devam etti.

extraMeanings.exampleEn: He was in a melancholy mood after the funeral.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Cenazeden sonra hüzünlü bir ruh hali içindeydi.

extraMeanings.exampleEn: The measured distance between the two points was exactly ten metres.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: İki nokta arasında ölçülen mesafe tam on metreydi.

extraMeanings.en: to prevent something from being seen or understood
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Thick clouds obscured the top of the mountain.

extraMeanings.en: above your head, in the sky
extraMeanings.exampleEn: A helicopter flew overhead as we walked.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Biz yürürken tepemizden bir helikopter geçti.

extraMeanings.en: a sudden sharp feeling of hunger
extraMeanings.exampleEn: I felt a pang of hunger halfway through the meeting.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Toplantının ortasında ani bir açlık hissi duydum.

extraMeanings.en: connected with fighting or war in character
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The music had a strong martial rhythm that stirred the crowd.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Müziğin, kalabalığı coşturan güçlü bir savaşçı ritmi vardı.
